name: Slow Burn
blurb: Flirty dares, sensual truths, tension you can feel.

cards.text: Describe our best kiss in detail. The other person is not allowed to interrupt until you're finished.
Kiss them like you mean it, then pull away first. That's the whole dare.
cards.soften: Three short kisses with eye contact between each.

cards.text: Trace their collarbone with one fingertip, unhurried.
cards.speak: While you do, say what you were thinking the first time you saw them tonight.
cards.soften: Trace their forearm instead.

cards.text: What do you think about when we're apart? Be specific — moments, not summaries.
Mutual gaze, one minute, zero words. Whoever speaks first pays a kiss toll.
cards.soften: Thirty seconds, eyes allowed to close.

cards.text: Slow dance with no music. Pick the tempo with your bodies, not your words.
cards.speak: Halfway through, whisper what you want tonight — the feeling, not the plan.
cards.soften: Just sway, no dare beyond that.

cards.text: When was the last time you felt genuinely wanted by me? What was I doing right?
Kiss their neck for 30 slow seconds.
cards.speak: While you do, tell them the moment this week you were proudest of them.
cards.soften: Forehead kiss plus the compliment.

cards.text: Trade answers: what makes you feel desired — being chased, being chosen, being claimed, or something else entirely?
Silence and skin: two minutes of touch with no talking. Describe nothing, ask nothing, just pay attention.
cards.soften: One minute, hands only above the shoulder.

cards.text: Describe out loud what you feel happening in your own body while they rest a hand on your heart. Full sentences. They just listen.
cards.speak: They repeat back the last sentence you said before you stop.
cards.soften: Describe one sensation, one sentence.

cards.text: Finish this: 'the moment I knew I was done for was…' Fill in every detail you remember.
Kiss down their neck, unhurried. Wherever you pause, say one true thing before moving on.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses, three true things.

cards.text: What's something you've been curious about with me but never brought up? Curiosity is the only price of admission.
Describe each other's body for sixty seconds using only words you'd want said about your soul.
cards.soften: One sentence each, whispered.

cards.text: Trace their lips with one finger. Their eyes stay closed.
cards.speak: Describe what you want to do next — starting every sentence with 'I want'. You don't have to do it yet.
cards.soften: Trace their hand instead. Same rule.

cards.text: Tell them about the last time a simple look from them made the air feel heavier.
What is one quiet way they pull you in that still catches you off guard?
Share a memory of a kiss that lingered longer than it needed to and why it stayed with you.
Describe the kind of tension you most want to build between you tonight.
When did you most recently feel that slow pull of wanting them closer without rushing?
What small detail about the way they kiss or lean in makes you want to stay right there?
Sixty-second gaze hold: sit close, eyes open, no words — just the quiet pull between you.
cards.soften: Hold soft eye contact for twenty seconds while smiling.

cards.text: Sync your breathing with theirs for one full minute while your foreheads rest together.
cards.soften: Share a few slow breaths while sitting close.

cards.text: Invite silence-with-touch: no words for ninety seconds while you keep continuous light contact — hands, arms, or resting close.
cards.soften: Stay quietly connected with a hand hold for thirty seconds.

cards.text: Lean in and offer a slow kiss that lasts at least ten seconds, then stay close enough to share breath afterward.
cards.speak: I could stay right here with you all night.
cards.soften: Give a soft, unhurried kiss and linger nearby.

cards.text: Near-kiss hold: hold the space just before your lips meet for twenty seconds, then close the distance.
cards.speak: I've been thinking about this exact moment.
cards.soften: Pause close for a few breaths before a gentle kiss.

cards.text: Offer a trail of three unhurried kisses along their jaw or neck while keeping your hands soft and still.
cards.speak: Every time I get this close I want to linger longer.
cards.soften: Place one slow kiss on their cheek and stay near.

cards.text: Pull them into a quiet embrace and stay there long enough for the rest of the room to fade, breathing together.
cards.speak: This is my favorite place to be.
cards.soften: Share a warm, unhurried hug.

cards.text: Kissing game: trade slow kisses, each one lasting longer than the last, up to five total.
cards.soften: Share three soft kisses with a short pause between each.

cards.text: Hold their face gently while you kiss them like you have all the time in the world.
cards.speak: I never get tired of the way you feel this close.
cards.soften: Cup their face for a single soft kiss.

cards.text: Invite the slowest, deepest kiss you can manage while pressing as close as clothing allows, letting the heat build without rushing past it.
cards.speak: I want you to feel how much I've been holding back.
cards.soften: Share a long, close kiss while holding them firmly.

cards.text: Together, keep continuous eye contact and light touch for a full minute without speaking, noticing every small shift in the other.
cards.soften: Hold hands and soft eye contact for twenty seconds.

cards.text: Sync your breathing while standing or sitting close, foreheads touching, for ninety seconds. Let the quiet do the work.
cards.soften: Share ten slow breaths together while close.

cards.text: Create a shared tension window: sit close enough to kiss but agree not to for two full minutes, letting the want build in the space between you.
cards.soften: Hold the almost-kiss distance for thirty seconds.

cards.text: Trade five slow kisses, alternating who leads, and after the last one stay pressed close in silence for thirty seconds.
cards.soften: Share three soft kisses and a short quiet hold.

cards.text: Talk about the kind of kiss that makes time feel slower for both of you.
Share what builds the best tension between you — distance, nearness, or the almost-touch.
Discuss a quiet moment of attraction from the past week that neither of you mentioned at the time.
What small, specific thing do you both want more of when the night turns slow and close?
Tell them about a shower or bath fantasy you've had that involves both of you and plenty of warm water.
What is one scent of theirs that immediately pulls up a close memory?
Describe how you would undress them with your eyes first if you had a full minute to just look.
Share a waking-up-together fantasy — the light, the temperature, the first touch.
What kind of thunderstorm-and-candles atmosphere makes you want to stay in and get closer?
Tell them one place on your body that always softens when their hands spend time there.
What slow kitchen moment between you still feels quietly charged when you remember it?
Describe the most lingering way you want to be touched right after a shared shower while skin is still warm.
Pull them onto your lap for a full minute. Hands slow and respectful on their back or waist.
cards.speak: Stay right here. I like the weight of you.
cards.soften: Invite a side-by-side lean with an arm around them.

cards.text: Offer a slow kitchen dance to whatever music is already playing, or to silence, keeping continuous light contact.
cards.speak: Move with me for a little while. Nothing else matters right now.
cards.soften: Sway together for twenty seconds in the kitchen.

cards.text: Run your fingers through their hair for sixty seconds. No agenda, just the touch.
cards.speak: I've been wanting to do this without rushing.
cards.soften: Offer a short, gentle hair touch or shoulder stroke.

cards.text: Whisper one private secret or desire into the space just beside their ear while your hand rests lightly on them.
cards.speak: I keep thinking about this when you're close.
cards.soften: Share the same thought at a soft normal volume.

cards.text: Dry them off or help with post-shower skin care using slow, deliberate hands if the setting allows.
cards.soften: Offer a soft towel-handed shoulder rub or lotion on their arms.

cards.text: Feed them a grape or berry from your fingers. Wait for them to take it.
cards.speak: Taste this. I want to watch.
cards.soften: Hand them a small bite in a regular way.

cards.text: Midnight-kitchen-encounter frame: you both just ended up here, the house is quiet, and neither of you is ready to say goodnight yet.
cards.speak: I was hoping I'd find you still awake.
cards.soften: Share a quiet 'I'm glad you're still up' moment in the kitchen.

cards.text: Home-alone tease: everything stays on, but spend two minutes moving and looking like the next layer could come off any second.
cards.speak: If we stayed in this feeling long enough I'd start undressing you with my hands next.
cards.soften: Spend a minute close and heated without changing anything about clothing.

cards.text: Offer a melting massage: slow hands on shoulders, neck, or scalp for ninety seconds while they do nothing but receive.
cards.speak: Let me take the day off you for a minute.
cards.soften: Give a short shoulder squeeze or neck rub.

cards.text: Dance to nothing — no music, just the rhythm you invent together while staying in contact.
cards.soften: Sway in place for a few breaths while holding on.

cards.text: Shower-and-steam fantasy, out loud: describe the water, the heat, and exactly how you'd pull them under with you.
cards.speak: I'd get in first and wait for you like this.
cards.soften: Describe a warm shared bath in softer detail.

cards.text: Hold them from behind for a full minute, chin near their shoulder, breathing together.
cards.speak: You fit here better than anywhere else.
cards.soften: Give a short standing hug from the side.

cards.text: Trace slow shapes on their palm or wrist while telling them one thing you love about their hands.
cards.speak: These hands do more to me than you know.
cards.soften: Hold their hand and mention one thing you like about it.

cards.text: Candles-and-low-light reset: dim what you can, sit close, and spend one minute only noticing each other's presence.
cards.soften: Turn down one light and sit quietly near each other.

cards.text: Together, take turns giving a two-minute melting shoulder-and-neck massage while the receiver stays completely still.
cards.soften: Trade one-minute gentle shoulder rubs.

cards.text: Create a shared shower-or-bath fantasy in three sentences each, then decide which details you both want to keep.
cards.soften: Each share one cozy water-related image involving both of you.

cards.text: Slow-dance in the kitchen or living room for one full song (or two minutes of silence), staying in continuous contact.
cards.soften: Sway together for thirty seconds.

cards.text: Take turns sitting on each other's lap for sixty seconds while trading one whispered want.
cards.soften: Share a side-by-side lean and one quiet wish.

cards.text: Together, build a short 'home alone' scene: lights low, phones away, and five minutes of only touch and quiet words as if the rest of the world is closed.
cards.soften: Spend two minutes close and phone-free with softer contact.

cards.text: Talk about the kind of post-shower or late-night skin-to-skin energy that feels most comforting to both of you.
Share what makes a kitchen or hallway moment suddenly feel charged instead of ordinary.
Discuss the difference between a quick kiss and the kind that rearranges the rest of the evening.
Talk about scent, skin, and the small physical details that make you feel most at home with each other.
Close their eyes. Map their forearm or shoulder slowly with just your fingertips.
cards.speak: I want to learn this part of you again.
cards.soften: Trace a short gentle line on their arm while they watch.

cards.text: Offer a shared blanket or throw and pull them in so you are both under it for a quiet minute.
cards.soften: Drape a blanket around both of you for a short moment.

cards.text: Whisper the first thing you would do if you woke up before them and wanted to start the day close.
cards.speak: I'd stay right here and wait for you to notice.
cards.soften: Share a soft morning-together wish out loud.

cards.text: One-minute 'look at me like we're already alone' pause — wherever you are, whatever the distance.
cards.soften: Share a longer-than-usual look with a smile.

cards.text: Tell them about a time a simple cheek touch with their thumb stayed with you longer than expected.
What is one physical feature of theirs you could appreciate out loud for a full minute?
Describe the lazy-Sunday-morning energy you most want to wake up inside together.
What does it feel like when they watch you get ready and you notice?
Share a late-night whisper you've held back that still wants to be said.
Where along your collarbone or neck do fingertips feel the most electric?
Drape a coat over their shoulders and walk the room or hallway together, your arm steadying them.
cards.speak: I've got you. Stay close.
cards.soften: Drape a blanket or sweater around their shoulders for a moment.

cards.text: Offer slow hands up the spine over clothing for forty-five seconds, checking in with your eyes.
cards.speak: Tell me if you want me to keep going.
cards.soften: Give a short, gentle back stroke instead.

cards.text: Kiss game with ice: hold a cube between lips or fingers, trace a cool path, warm it with a kiss.
cards.speak: Cold first… then me.
cards.soften: Skip the ice and offer a single warm kiss.

cards.text: Offer a candlelight massage with unscented lotion on shoulders or hands for two full minutes.
cards.speak: Let me take my time with you.
cards.soften: Give a short shoulder rub without lotion.

cards.text: Stand behind them while they pretend to cook or stand at a counter and leave three slow shoulder kisses.
cards.speak: You look good even when you're not trying.
cards.soften: Give one soft kiss on the shoulder from the side.

cards.text: Nose-to-nose breathing pause, thirty seconds. Eyes open or closed.
cards.speak: Just breathe with me.
cards.soften: Share a shorter forehead-to-forehead moment.

cards.text: Dress them for the next part of the evening — choose one item and help them into it slowly.
cards.speak: I want to be the one who puts this on you.
cards.soften: Hand them one item and help with a sleeve or button.

cards.text: Invite permission to brush or run your fingers through their hair for a full minute.
cards.speak: I've been wanting to do this without rushing.
cards.soften: Offer a short, gentle hair touch.

cards.text: Goodnight-kiss ritual right now: the kind that says the day is done and you're still choosing each other.
cards.speak: This is the kiss I want ending our nights.
cards.soften: Share a soft, unhurried goodnight-style kiss.

cards.text: Shower-steam-kiss-adjacent moment: describe or enact the heat of kissing just outside a steamy bathroom door, close enough to feel the warmth.
cards.speak: I'd pull you in before the steam even clears.
cards.soften: Share a warm, close kiss with a softer steam fantasy.

cards.text: Offer hotel-room-energy roleplay for three minutes: the door just closed, the rest of the world is elsewhere, and you finally have privacy.
cards.speak: We've been waiting for this room all day.
cards.soften: Create a shorter 'just us' pause with lower heat.

cards.text: Hold their hand and stroke your thumb slowly across their skin for a full minute without speaking.
cards.soften: Hold hands with a few gentle thumb strokes.

cards.text: Together, take turns giving a two-minute candlelit hand or shoulder massage with lotion while the other simply receives.
cards.soften: Trade one-minute gentle massages.

cards.text: Build a blanket-burrito cuddle: wrap yourselves in the same blanket and stay inside it for three full minutes.
cards.soften: Share a shorter blanket cocoon.

cards.text: Do a favorite-feature appreciation rotation: each person gets ninety seconds to speak about one physical detail they love while touching it lightly.
cards.soften: Each share one appreciative sentence with a soft touch.

cards.text: Create a shared slow-hug contest: hold a hug for at least ten full seconds, then see if you both want to double it.
cards.soften: Share one lingering hug of any length.

cards.text: Talk about the difference between a quick goodnight kiss and the kind that rewrites the end of the day.
Share what lazy-Sunday-morning energy needs in order to stay unbroken.
Discuss the small physical rituals — hair, hands, shoulders — that make ordinary moments feel chosen.
